INTEGRITY / PROVENANCE REPORT
=============================

Generator:    tooltip-plugin
Public page:  https://perchance.org/tooltip-plugin
Export date:  2026-09-16T17:32:55.241Z

Third-party code is INLINED inside generator/main.pjs, in the body of getTippyJSText(), which
injects a <script> into document.head the first time $output() is called. Both vendored
libraries were extracted from main.pjs and compared against their canonical upstream releases
(whitespace normalised, template-literal escaping reversed).

1) @popperjs/core 2.5.2  (dist/umd/popper.min.js)
   Upstream URL:   https://unpkg.com/@popperjs/core@2.5.2/dist/umd/popper.min.js
   Upstream bytes: 18309
   Inlined bytes:  18221
   Code identical to upstream: YES
   Only difference: upstream's banner comment ('/** @popperjs/core v2.5.2 - MIT License */') and its
                    trailing '//# sourceMappingURL=popper.min.js.map' comment.
   sha256 upstream file : b341df65f4ae526103325a74b19e05a97cc89e0ad232816bfe853a56831068a9
   sha256 inlined copy  : 24599d610f3d4968d982d925f2d1ad9a976719b6c08f1405e71d3b9c54abcf61

2) tippy.js 6.2.6  (dist/tippy-bundle.umd.min.js)
   Upstream URL:   https://unpkg.com/tippy.js@6.2.6/dist/tippy-bundle.umd.min.js
   Upstream bytes: 23563
   Inlined bytes:  23513
   Code identical to upstream: YES
   Only difference: the trailing '//# sourceMappingURL=tippy-bundle.umd.min.js.map' comment.
   sha256 upstream file : 8cde69e77bbfcfac376856b583f415542edbe95778c4dc66d9c12c737bc410f1
   sha256 inlined copy  : ff50d62a79e5b11865a87be7168e71d43860c9e7608d499a23e2d0d611baf8da

Attribution comments embedded in generator/main.pjs (verbatim, first line of each vendored block):

   /* https://unpkg.com/@popperjs/core@2.5.2/dist/umd/popper.min.js - Copyright (C) Federico Zivolo 2019, Distributed under the MIT License (license terms are at http://opensource.org/licenses/MIT). */
   /* https://unpkg.com/tippy.js@6.2.6/dist/tippy-bundle.umd.min.js */

Escaping note: the inlined copies sit inside a JS template literal, so every backslash appears
doubled and any backtick or dollar-brace sequence is escaped. Files under dependencies/embedded/
have that escaping reversed, so they are valid, runnable JavaScript.

Project's own code: generator/main.pjs and generator/index.html are reproduced byte-exactly as
served by the generator. No other file participates at runtime. Assets: none.
